title: Pod Salt Nexus Mango Strawberry Peach 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Mango Strawberry Peach from Pod Salt Nexus brings together the tropical allure of ripe Mangoes, the succulent charm of Strawberries, and the juicy sweetness of Peaches. This combination offers a harmonious experience of fruit flavours, each with a sun-ripened sweetness that’s utterly irresistible. With a generous 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid in every bottle, shortfill bottles from Pod Salt Nexus are designed for those who crave more of their favourite flavours. Additionally, they offer an extra 20ml space for a duo of nicotine shots, putting you in the driver’s seat when it comes to personalising your nicotine strength. To achieve 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply add 2 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shots to the 100ml shortfill, give it a good shake, and you've crafted your ideal shortfill. The brilliance of shortfills lies not only in their larger volumes but also in their economical value. Enhanced with a higher VG content, these e-liquids work seamlessly with high-powered, sub-ohm vape kits and low-resistance coils, ensuring an impeccable balance of flavour and vapour. Elevate the longevity and pleasure of your vaping routine by opting for these larger volume Shortfills. Pod Salt Nexus prides themselves on an unparalleled selection of shortfill e-liquids. Their meticulously crafted flavours, covering a spectrum from Fruits and Desserts to Drinks and Candy, and many uniquely enticing flavours found nowhere else, are a testament to their commitment to quality and flavour. As you explore the offerings of Pod Salt Nexus, every bottle is an invitation to discover a new favourite in the vast world of vaping.
